web_events.answer: This week, U.S. economic data will be heavily focused on labor market indicators and inflation measures. Key reports include the September Employment Situation report on Friday, which will provide insights into nonfarm payrolls, and the August Personal Consumption Expenditures Price Index (PCE) data on Thursday, which includes the Federal Reserve's preferred inflation gauge. Additionally, the Bureau of Economic Analysis (BEA) will release its August PCE data, along with revisions to GDP and PCE.
